selection_rule: mean validation IQ MSE over all 3 replicates; exact recorded-score tie: lower RMPS, then lower table row

source.guard_exclusions: CLI dispatch, prose, report modules; observed hashes retained, resolved configs guarded

test_protocol.metrics: direct Gray BER X/Y/total, Clopper-Pearson95%, BER-derived Q; MSE/EVM/SNR auxiliary
test_protocol.normalization: unit-Es from frozen receiver and known physical power; no test-label fitting
test_protocol.paper_agreement: absolute Q and delta-Q, frame/replicate variability; no justified numeric acceptance tolerance
